title: HarriAddon: Generated Story
description: Addon for the HarriAddons: Gaming Suite mod hub, which features a generated comic with all your favorite HAGS characters!
body:
**⚠️ This addon features the use of generative AI for the comic pages. We at HAGS do not support the commercial use of generative AI, and are simply using the images for a demonstration of the HAGS API and Harri Addons, and comedic effect. We are making fun of slop. This project will never be monetized. Please use generative AI sparingly.**

Download with the main HarriAddons: Gaming Suite and enable under the "Addons" tab to view your comics!

- Features an addon containing 10 Acts of epic HAGS comics telling an epic tale of coffee, goblins, chaos, and M7 Guides!
- Feel yourself climbing and growing alongside the HAGS crew as you chase new PBs!
- Discover the true meaning of Ascent!

Note: All Addons are accessible in the "Harri Addons" tab of the main HarriAddons: Gaming Suite mod.
